# Rabble & Rouse with Katie Martell

Rabble & Rouse with Katie Martell is a late-night talk show and video podcast, filmed live in front of a studio audience at Triad Studios. The show shines a spotlight on ordinary people with extraordinary lived experiences. Late night… for real life.

## Host

Katie Martell is a professional rabble-rouser and unapologetic truth-teller. With Rabble & Rouse, she shines a spotlight on extraordinary lived experiences. Website: https://www.katie-martell.com

## Episode 01: Cheryl Katon

Page: https://rabble-rouse.vercel.app/episode-1
Status: Out now
Guest: Cheryl Katon

Katie sits down with the bravest woman we know to discuss growing up trans, living authentically, and the cost of visibility.

What is the impact of visibility? What is the cost? Host Katie Martell sits down with Cheryl Katon, LGBTQ+ advocate, nonprofit CEO, Eagle Scout, and quite simply, the bravest woman we know.

Cheryl shares her experience growing up trans in Boston in the 70s and 80s before having the language for it, secretly searching library shelves, finding her community, navigating loss, marriage and transition, and eventually becoming a CEO in Texas.

We explore the power and complicated cost of visibility, queer history, trans joy, meaningful allyship, and Cheryl's very simple "trans agenda": helping people feel seen, heard, and able to become who they are.

Plus: Explain Like I'm Cis, an alarming amount of knot-tying expertise, and the world's tiniest trophy.

## Episode 02: Mistress Eustacia

Page: https://rabble-rouse.vercel.app/episode-2
Status: Coming soon
Guest: Mistress Eustacia

Katie sits down with a professional dominatrix to explore power exchange, setting better boundaries, and what it really means to give up control.

Katie sits down with professional dominatrix, EMT, and helicopter pilot Mistress Eustacia for a thoughtful conversation about what it really means to give up control, power exchange, consent, vulnerability, and what actually happens inside a professional dungeon.

Mistress Eustacia shares her philosophy on setting boundaries, protecting your peace, getting comfortable saying no, and recognizing all the places we surrender our power without realizing it, from relationships to social media. And yes, there is rope.
